structured.rankingRationale: OENOVITI ranks highest for La Côte geography and a non-hotel host; devopsdays follows for non-hotel venue and participant-arranged lodging; IAS is high-value because expected attendance is explicitly published but venue/housing is unresolved. Venue-committed Geneva events rank below these because they are competitive intelligence or future capture, not open current inventory.
notesForDeepResearch: Prioritize OENOVITI and devopsdays for non-hotel/local lodging pathways.
For Palexpo events, test official partner-hotel, overflow and participant-arranged channels.
Treat IAS venue/housing as an immediate verification gap.
materialUncertainties: Dates and venues are verified, but most hotel sourcing, room blocks and peak rooms are not published.
Confirmed competitor/non-hotel venues are not treated as open YOTEL inventory.
Geneva is secondary territory; fit is based on airport-corridor, overflow, side-event, participant-arranged or future-edition logic.

result.text: 12 future event-driven opportunities for YOTEL Geneva Lake, focused on La Côte, Geneva Airport corridor and relevant Geneva demand.
